scope: Proposition 11.28 (Circuits from protected annuli) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 152-153. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose an acyclic center component at a uniform level Xj ∈ [aNj, bNj] admits the following construction, with probability tending to one on that event. It has a retained auxiliary disk and a compact annulus around the component point such that: 152 (i) the original lattice patch agrees with the auxiliary patch by Lemma 11.23, including the full stars needed for separation; (ii) the preimage of the inner disk contains a time neighborhood of each relevant base of radius δjrj(Xj), where δ−1 j is tight; the full preimage of the closed outer disk lies in finitely many retained intervals, each of length at most Mjrj(Xj), with both the number and Mj tight; (iii) finitely many tube crossings of the annulus, arranged to intersect successively and to wind around the inner disk, have total all-edge cost CjB(rj(Xj)), with Cj tight; (iv) all these patches lie in the required base spatial neighborhood. Assume 1 < a0 < a < b, s′ < s, and B(r)/B(nj) ≤ K(r/nj)s on the used lattice scales. Then the original map has a surrounding circuit of cost at most B(nj)e−s′Nj with probability tending to one. Its interior contains the base time neighborhood of radius nje−bNj and its closed interior contains no uninterrupted contour time interval of length nje−a0Nj .
